tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: The 48 countries whose label law Drict checks, each with its code and the products it is checked for (food and drinks, cosmetics, other goods, medical devices, supplements, alcohol, pet food, batteries, electrical goods, chemicals, toys, textiles — where covered; Vietnam has its own eleven).

tools.name: check_label
tools.description: Check the printed text of a product label against the label law of the country where it is sold. tools.name: list_requirements
tools.description: What the label law of a country asks a product's label to carry, before a label exists: the mandatory items, the items needed only in some cases, the language rule and what to check by eye, each with its law and the official sources. Use it to write or brief a label; use check_label to check one.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_label" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
